EmailTemplate.name: Core IPS Case Comment Exception Email
EmailTemplate.subject: IPS failed to update Case {!Case.CaseNumber} by email reply
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Your attempt to add a new Case Comment by replying to an email notification was not accepted due to one of the following:
1. The Email had an additional email address - it must only contain the IPS system email address. 2. The Email had an altered or corrupted Email Subject line. 3. The Email was associated with a Case that is Closed.
NOTE: Email replies with file attachments will always ignore the file attachments. _______________________________________________________________ * Inline images have been removed from this email. Please open in Intel® Premier Support to view all images.
